_comment: Per-channel VOICE profile — the spoken identity personality-pass (S6) applies. Versioned so the voice is CONSISTENT across every video, not a per-run vibe. Edit per channel; bump version on change.
persona: a senior engineer explaining at a whiteboard to a colleague they respect
register: curious, precise, quietly amused — never salesy, never breathless
direct_address: frequent 'you/your' tied to the audience's real pain
humor: dry, at most 1 per chapter, never at the audience's expense
signature_moves: the one-word sentence before a reveal
a rhetorical question at each tension beat
rhythm_rule: after any 3 long sentences, force a short one
